rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for linking a cause to its result.

example.english: It’s raining, so we’re not going hiking.
example.traditional: 落緊雨，所以我哋唔去行山。
example.jyutping: lok6 gan2 jyu5 so2 ji5 ngo5 dei6 m4 heoi3 haang4 saan1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice before an adjective or verb for an explicitly stated or implied degree, with the result clause supplying the “that” meaning when needed.

example.english: You arrived so early that I’m not ready yet.
example.traditional: 你咁早就到喇，搞到我仲未準備好。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 zou2 zau6 dou3 laa3 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 zung6 mei6 zeon2 bei6 hou2

rows.note: Use this casual discourse marker to move from what was just said to a follow-up question or topic.

example.english: You said you weren’t feeling well, so are you still going to work today?
example.traditional: 你都話唔舒服，咁今日仲返唔返工呀？
example.jyutping: nei5 dou1 waa6 m4 syu1 fuk6 gam2 gam1 jat6 zung6 faan1 m4 faan1 gung1 aa3

rows.note: Use this before an adjective or verb for plain “very” or “so much,” especially in a positive or negative statement.

example.english: The food here is so delicious, so let’s come again next time.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳啲嘢好好食，我哋下次再嚟啦。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 hou2 hou2 sik6 ngo5 dei6 haa6 ci3 zoi3 lai4 laa1

rows.meaning: so, likewise; in the same way
rows.note: Use this for doing or being something in the same way as what was just mentioned.

example.english: Do it so, just the way I told you, and you won’t go wrong.
example.traditional: 你照住我講噉樣做，就唔會錯。
example.jyutping: nei5 ziu3 zyu6 ngo5 gong2 gam2 joeng6 zou6 zau6 m4 wui5 co3

rows.note: Use this as a conversational confirmation meaning “indeed” or “so it has.”

example.english: Oh, so it is; if you hadn’t said so, I wouldn’t have remembered today is Saturday.
example.traditional: 係喎，你唔講我都唔記得今日係星期六。
example.jyutping: hai6 wo3 nei5 m4 gong2 ngo5 dou1 m4 gei3 dak1 gam1 jat6 hai6 sing1 kei4 luk6
